{{Quote|My client is in a situation. Hired guns, looking to put him out of business the old fashioned way. Losing my client would destroy this community. I've stepped up to keep that from happening-think you could do the same?|Neb Munb|<ref name="TOR" />}}
The '''client''' of the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Neb Munb]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked for a [[Unidentified vaporator corporation|corporation]] that produced [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|moisture vaporators]]. Representing the corporation's charitable arm, he sold vaporators at a steep discount on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TOR" />
